releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.6 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Fix Cancel Mis-Click: PocketFM Playing next ad in X countdown cards are strictly protected as transition screens; cancel is permanently blacklisted
* Fix Top-Left Ad Dismissal: Gated fast-forward stencil to landscape orientation to eliminate false positives on portrait text, prioritized top-left circled cross badges in portrait, and added early top-left fallback taps at count 3
* Enhanced Ad Surface Detection: ScreenClassifier now detects SurfaceView, TextureView, and bare corner buttons without normal PocketFM UI
* Version bumped to v1.0.6 (Build 7)
